design_detail: Net-wealth tax (with a capital gains tax) expected in the 2021 national budget
quote_original: We also expect the government to introduce the long-awaited capital gains tax and categorical net-wealth tax to further expand tax and/or revenue base.
source_title: Budget must underscore progressive fiscal reform to enhance domestic revenue mobilization while prioritizing expenditure
publisher: Lusaka Times (statement by Nalucha Nganga Ziba, Country Director, ActionAid Zambia)
grading_note: Own pre-budget statement by the Country Director for ActionAid Zambia; asks for a net-wealth tax by name, no rate or threshold, so B.

design_detail: A wealth tax on high-income earners, with higher income-tax bands and a wealth registry
quote_original: there is need for government to create a ‘wealth tax’ where the country’s high-income earners can contribute towards funding development and narrow the huge inequality gap
source_title: Zambia needs 'wealth tax' to narrow inequality gap, ActionAid tips govt
grading_note: Reporter paraphrases the ActionAid tax advisor in a radio interview ahead of the 2021 budget (the page also quotes him asking for "a registry for wealth taxes"); named but unspecified, so B.

design_detail: Introduce wealth taxes; ZRA unit for high net worth individuals
quote_original: One major flaw in the Zambian tax regime is the absence of wealth taxes. The implementation of wealth taxes would significantly reduce wealth inequality and generate additional revenue in a progressive manner.
source_title: Zambia Fair Tax Monitor (FTM) Report, September 2020
grading_note: Authored report (Oxfam Zambia funded) that has a section on wealth tax and recommends introducing wealth taxes plus a HNWI unit at the revenue authority; no rate or threshold, graded A as an authored publication recommending the tax.

design_detail: 1% wealth tax and 10% income tax on Africa's richest 1% (letter to President Ramaphosa)
source_title: Open letter to President Cyril Ramaphosa: Africa's time to lead the world
grading_note: Listed among the 82 signatory organisations of a letter that asks the G20 presidency to back a 1% wealth tax on Africa's richest 1%; the signatory list is the campaign's claim, so B until a statement of its own is found.

design_detail: New wealth tax on luxury real estate, offshore assets and unproductive domestic capital (plus an escalating land holdings tax)
quote_original: the plan proposes a new wealth tax targeting luxury real estate, offshore assets, and unproductive domestic capital
source_title: M'membe Lays Out Sweeping Reform Agenda Ahead of Hichilema's Second-Term Inauguration
grading_note: Reporter's account of M'membe's policy manifesto published on the eve of the 1 September 2026 inauguration; manifesto text not found, so B. The wealth tax is separate from the land tax, which is not counted.
